reviews.text: Great app, and excellent service; my dog ​​seems quite happy.

It's a great app and service because it allows you to see in real time how and where your dog is being walked, as well as when your dog is relieving itself. If the user wishes, they can also contact the walker via regular phone calls or video calls to check on their dog. It's also a good service because walkers are required to be responsible and punctual in caring for their clients' dogs.
Highly recommended, it has helped me a lot personally, excellent treatment and dedication towards my pets when we go for walks with them.

I don't recommend this; don't download it. It's a business with absolutely no regard for dogs. They assigned my 40-kilo dog a very thin walker, completely out of proportion to my baby's reactivity and size, which endangers both the dog and the person. They claim they'll take care of it if something happens, but honestly, you have to be incredibly ignorant to put both people and dogs at risk. They don't evaluate anything; it's purely about making money, with no compassion for the dogs. To top it off, the salesperson blocked me on WhatsApp, clearly demonstrating their lack of ethics and professional commitment: this project is horrendous.
